integrity.evidence: The proof supplies explicit enumeration, classical divisor-sum asymptotics and justified limit exchanges; verify.py is an independent finite composition check and does not establish infinite theorems.

limitations: Integer-parameter consecutive-diagonal rook inverse monoids only; nonzero nilpotents sampled uniformly. The elementwise nilpotency-index formula, monoid cardinality and total nilpotent count are prior results. Asymptotics concern n tending to infinity; no extension to the full rook monoid or real-parameter supermonoid is claimed. Global publication priority is not certified.
title: Heavy-tailed nilpotency depth in consecutive-diagonal rook monoids
